metadata.title: ReelClip: prep long footage for your next edit
metadata.description: Cut long footage into smaller clips, export to Photos, then create with CapCut, YouTube Shorts, or any editor you like.
metadata.openGraphDescription: Cut long footage into smaller clips, export to Photos, then create in the editor you already use.

hero.heading: Cut long videos into clips for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts.
hero.body: Start with one longer recording, or add several scenes to one project. ReelClip helps you choose the moments, then lines them up for export, ready for CapCut, Shorts, or any editor.
hero.editorAlt: ReelClip editor showing a scene preview and planned clips timeline

stats.detail: Keep every shoot in one project

stats.label: Ready to export
stats.detail: Send a tidy batch to Photos

modes.heading: Keep a whole shoot in one project.
modes.headingMuted: Switch scenes, then choose the cut.
modes.body: Add separate videos as scenes, move between them without losing your place, and choose the cut mode that gets each part of the shoot ready fastest.
modes.timelineAlt: ReelClip timeline with scene controls and a clip preview

items.name: Cut
items.description: Choose how many clips you want and how long each should be. Ideal for recurring series, podcast excerpts, and scheduled posts.

items.name: Transcript
items.tagline: Cuts that land on natural pauses.
items.description: Finds natural pauses in speech so cuts feel cleaner. If there are no clear pauses, ReelClip keeps the timing consistent.

items.name: Splice
items.tagline: Find the moments that stand out.
items.description: ReelClip reads movement, faces, sharpness, and audio to find the strongest moments, all on your iPhone.

items.name: AI Assist
items.tagline: Describe what you want. Get a clip plan.
items.description: Ask for the funniest moments, the product demo, or the strongest quotes. Apple Intelligence reads the transcript on your iPhone and suggests clips. Nothing is uploaded and you don't need an account.

safety.heading: You make the final cut.
safety.headingMuted: Nothing saves until you say so.
safety.body: ReelClip shows every suggested clip before saving anything to Photos. Review the moment, adjust the trim, and export only what you want.
safety.imageAlt: ReelClip home screen showing a saved project and import options
pills: Nothing is saved until you approve it
Every clip can be reviewed and adjusted first
Analysis happens on-device. Your video stays on your phone

aiNotes.heading: The AI runs on your iPhone.
aiNotes.body: ReelClip uses Apple Intelligence to help you find moments worth keeping. It runs entirely on your iPhone. Your video never leaves your device.
canDoItems: Read your transcript to understand what was said and find moments like hooks, quotes, or key topics
Check still frames across your video for objects, on-screen text, and faces, and note when each appears
Combine what it sees with what was said, so prompts like “remove the product shots” or “keep the talking-to-camera parts” work
Suggest clip ranges or passage removals you can review, adjust, and approve before anything is saved
cantDoItems: Watch full video in motion. It samples still frames at intervals and reads the transcript, but cannot follow action or pacing between frames
Understand audio emotionally (tone, sarcasm, music). It reads transcript text and audio levels
Take in a very long video all at once. Past a point it has to work in sections
aiNotes.limitsHeading: These limits come from the model, not the app
aiNotes.limitsBody: The list above describes what Apple's on-device model can handle today. When Apple improves it, ReelClip picks up the improvement.
aiNotes.footnote: Apple Intelligence requires iOS 26 and a supported device. It can be turned off at any time in Settings. When unavailable, ReelClip falls back to on-device audio and visual analysis without any AI features.

compatible.heading: See every chosen clip before it leaves ReelClip.
compatible.body: Your chosen clips from every scene sit together in one list. Check what you're keeping, then send the whole set to Photos and build the final post with the tools you already use.
compatible.imageAlt: ReelClip showing a planned set of clips ready to save or export

items.description: Bring prepared clips into CapCut and drop them into templates, captions, sound, and effects.
Use smaller source clips in Edits to build Reels with filters, music, and finishing touches.
Use your exported clips as source footage when you create and publish YouTube Shorts.

cta.heading: Download ReelClip.
cta.body: ReelClip is available on the App Store for iPhone running iOS 26 or later.

footer.description: Turn long footage into smaller clips for your next edit. Review every cut, export to Photos, then create in CapCut, Shorts, or any editor you like.
footer.devicePromise: Built for iPhone. Your footage never leaves your device.
